nodeGroups.name: CheckCandidateAndPrerequisites
nodeGroups.description: Read-only checks reject stale versions, saved pins, fixture drift, pending inputs and unfinished prior sessions.

nodeGroups.name: OpenSupervisedSession
nodeGroups.description: Record hashes and restoration intent, reject concurrent sessions, then establish a real Gmail polling checkpoint.

nodeGroups.name: RunSelectedCases
nodeGroups.description: Send one fresh source per case; bounded observer checks real main/Gmail evidence before the next send.

nodeGroups.name: RestoreAndReport
nodeGroups.description: Restore only runner-changed operating state, verify candidate parity and record truthful Regression or Demo results.
